event_name: Document 42 Date 28 April 2019 Time 15:18 2019 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 April 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 40), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The LHS and RHS front wing flap adjuster hook has been changed to a different specification.
offence: Breach of Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The stewards reviewed the evidence from the Technical Delegate and determined that as the wing flap adjuster hook is of a different specification from the one used during qualifying the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Offence Car 7 Wing Flap Adjuster Hook
